div.head: Meeting with Dr. Johann Heiss
div.p: 1st September 2022: Social anthropologist and Arabist Dr. Johann Heiss is invited to the WIBARAB office to deliver a talk on complex tribal structures with a focus on Yemeni bedouins. Dr. Heiss also addresses some problematic questions that the PhD students came up with during the course of their research.
